format: gzipped TSV, three columns: language (ISO 639-1), country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 lowercase), tagged address. The address column is space-separated token/label pairs, for example 'Parkstraße/road 8/house_number |/FSEP 6OG/level'; '|/FSEP' marks a field separator and ',/SEP' a separator token.
